description: Defines the LoanChargePaidBy entity, representing a record of a loan charge paid by a specific transaction within the loan portfolio domain of the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanChargePaidBy
classes.description: Entity class representing a record of a payment made towards a specific loan charge, linked to a loan transaction and a loan charge.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the amount paid towards the charge.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount paid towards the charge.

methods.name: getInstallmentNumber
methods.description: Returns the installment number associated with the payment, if applicable.
